name: Cham cheo
summary: Chẩm chéo is the valley’s dipping sauce: toasted mắc khén pounded with fresh chili, ginger, salt, and herbs, with more mắc khén stirred in. It goes with boiled, roasted, and grilled meat, and above all with boiled Cổ Lũng duck.
origin: Pù Luông. Source: Hải Vân, The Thanh Hoa Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism, 16 May 2022.
taste: Made for boiled, roasted, and grilled meat.
howToEat: As a dip with the meat, not a plate on its own.
Pound toasted mắc khén with fresh chili, ginger, salt, rau thơm, húng, mùi tàu, and rau mùi ta, then stir in more mắc khén.
where: The meal in the valley. Buy the mắc khén seed at Phố Đoàn.
seoTitle: Cham cheo in Pu Luong — dip for Co Lung duck
seoDescription: Chẩm chéo is mắc khén, fresh chili, ginger, salt, and herbs, pounded into the dip for boiled Cổ Lũng duck.
